request: allow me to have a tab system and filter system to view our achievements by type, enemy, player, completion etc.

tabs.label: TYPE
tabs.values: the 8 families, derived from the rows

tabs.label: ENEMY
tabs.values: stages 1-9, offered only for rows won against a unit

tabs.label: PILOT
tabs.values: the 9 pilots, from the definition's own pilot plus the unlock meta

controls.fire: cycle the value in this tab

design_rules.rule: every tab's values are DERIVED from the rows, never hand-listed
design_rules.why: _selfPat, the edge-pin exemption list and the enemy-separation list were each a hand-written list that went stale the moment something new arrived, and each cost a drop
design_rules.effect: a family added later appears in TYPE on its own; a family with no rows cannot appear at all
design_rules.asserted: no family present in achievementList() may be missing from the tab

design_rules.rule: ENEMY is the encounter axis, not every row carrying a stage
design_rules.why: clearing stage 4 without dying is about the STAGE; beating its boss on Furious is about the BOSS - offering both would make ENEMY a second copy of STAGE CLEAR

design_rules.rule: the header counts the FILTERED set
design_rules.why: '0 OF 66' over four rows is a lie about the thing on screen; the POINTS stay the profile total because that is a score, not a count

design_rules.rule: an empty filter says NOTHING HERE YET
design_rules.why: a blank panel reads as broken

data_faults_found.what: the four stage-1 speed awards carried no `stage` field
data_faults_found.detail: their ids and titles say 'Stage 1' (stage1_boss_under_60 and friends) but their defs held only {family, role, seconds}, so ENEMY showed stage 1 its 2 boss_difficulty rows and none of its 4 speed rows
data_faults_found.verdict: the filter was right and the data was short a field
data_faults_found.fix: stage:1 added to all four; stage 1 now shows 6
data_faults_found.found_by: reading the probe's own numbers - nothing failed, the tab worked exactly as written

data_faults_found.what: 60 of the 66 grants never recorded who was flying
data_faults_found.detail: the only pilot in the system was the `pilot` field on the nine campaign-clear DEFINITIONS; achievementRunComplete put pilot in its meta but achievementStageComplete, achievementEncounterDefeat and achievementWeaponMax built their meta inline with only mode/difficulty/stage
data_faults_found.consequence: a PILOT tab over that data could only ever show one row per pilot
data_faults_found.fix: achievementMeta(extra) is the single funnel - pilot, co-op second seat, mode, difficulty - and all three grant sites go through it
data_faults_found.limitation: unlocks already in a player's localStorage have no pilot, so a pre-0916 save shows the PILOT tab its campaign-clear rows and nothing else; that is the stored data, not the filter, and the tab does not pretend otherwise

load_bearing_assertion.what: one press moves EXACTLY one tab
load_bearing_assertion.why: Input.menuLeft/menuRight CONSUME their tap, and CLAUDE.md's worked example of getting it wrong - d = menuLeft() ? -1 : 1 - is always +1 because the second call was eaten by the first. A probe that only checked 'the tab changed' would pass on that bug.

suite.baseline: 4,647 ok / 56 fail at a clean worktree on 9f64e731
